trap.label: gostar + -ing e condicional
trap.wrong: I enjoyed to work with numbers; if I would stay, I regret it.
trap.right: I enjoyed working with numbers; if I stayed, I would regret it.
trap.why: Em português “gostei de trabalhar” usa infinitivo e “se eu ficasse, me arrependeria” usa subjuntivo. Em inglês, enjoy + -ing; if + Past, would + base.

opts: If I would leave, I regret.
